title: A merger reading an author's cited review result gets 404 "review attempt has no confirmed publication"
outcome: An eligible root of the original review project (such as the Engram Merger) can read a review attempt's published structured result by delegation id, attempt and result id when the author cites it as clean, or receives a precise reason (for example custody rows missing after a restart, or the attempt never published) and a supported recovery route.
acceptance: For the two reported attempts (Codex delegation 94507c51…, attempt 1, result 14cd14d8…; Claude delegation 083c0411…, attempt 2, result 68c64a3f…), the reason termal_get_session_result returns 404 at delegation_review_attempts.rs:372 (no review custody rows) is established: never published, custody lost (for example across restart #3), or a project-basis / eligibility mismatch.

Either the published results become readable through the supported route, or the error names the specific cause and a recovery path; a regression test covers the established case and the review pair is clean.
